starting-off.text: Boo hoo! Oh dear, my only daughter....

steps.player: What's the matter?

steps.speaker: Irena
steps.text: Oh dear... my daughter, Ana, has gone missing in the desert. I fear that she is lost, or perhaps... *sob* even worse.

steps.player: When did she go into the desert?

steps.text: Sob* she went in there just a few days ago, *Sob* she said she would be back yesterday.

steps.speaker: Irena
steps.text: Sob* And she's not...

steps.player: I'll find her for you!

steps.speaker: Irena
steps.text: Oh thank you! You've made me a very happy mother, I just hope it's not too late!

steps.player: Do you have any ideas on where she may have gone?

steps.speaker: Irena
steps.text: I did go looking for her myself and I came across some footprints just a little way south. I'm worried that they lead to the desert mining camp!

steps.player: Oh... Well I hope you find her.

options.text: Cheer up, it might never happen.

steps.player: Cheer up, it might never happen.

steps.speaker: Irena
steps.text: It may already have happened you thoughtless oaf! My daughter, Ana, has gone missing in the desert. I fear that she is lost, or perhaps... *sobs* even worse.

steps.player: When did she go into the desert?

steps.speaker: Irena
steps.text: Sob* she went in there just a few days ago, *Sob* she said she would be back yesterday.

starting-off-talking-to-irena-again.speaker: Irena
starting-off-talking-to-irena-again.text: Please bring my daughter back to me. She is most likely list in the Desert somewhere. I miss her so much... Wahhhhh! *Sob*

options.text: Do you know where Ana went?

steps.player: Do you know where Ana went?

steps.speaker: Irena
steps.text: I did look for her myself and a little way south. I came across some footprints which may be hers. I'm worried that she may have been caught by some guards and taken to work in that terrible desert mine to the south.

options.text: Is there anywhere around here that she would go?

steps.player: Is there anywhere around here that she would go?

steps.speaker: Irena
steps.text: I think she may have just gone a little way into the desert. It's unlike her to go too far away. She is an adventurous girl, but she knows how I worry. She wouldn't go too far.

options.text: Where do you think I should start my search?

steps.player: Where do you think I should start my search?

steps.speaker: Irena
steps.text: I think I saw some of her footprints to the south, you could start there. Hopefully she'll just be over a few sand dunes, but you never know. She may have been taken to that awful desert mining camp or captured by

steps.speaker: Irena
steps.text: brigands!

steps.player: Okay, thanks.

starting-off-looking-at-the-footprints.text: This looks like some disturbed sand. Footsteps seem to be heading off towards the South.

starting-off-searching-the-footprints.text: You search the footsteps more closely. You can see that there are five sets of footprints. One set of footprints seems lighter than the others. The four other footsteps were made by heavier people with boots.

starting-off-inspecting-a-cactus-with-a-.text: You remember that Irena mentioned something about Ana wearing a red scarf before she left for the desert.

options.text: Is Al Zaba Bhasim very tough?
